page.notes: Printed page with running text only. The opening quotation-mark marks at each line start are printed signs; the text is reproduced as printed. Some words are doubtful in the scan, e.g. "exisferent" (likely existerent) and "sub" and "sive" readings; the words "Mosis" and "Moses" are copied as shown.
